stops.name: Krimml Waterfalls
stops.quote: The Krimml Waterfalls in the Hohe Tauern National Park are the highest waterfalls in Europe.
stops.english: The Krimml Waterfalls in the Hohe Tauern National Park are the highest waterfalls in Europe.

stops.name: lowest waterfall
stops.quote: The barrier-free path leads from the car parks to the lowest waterfall, including wheelchair-accessible toilets.
stops.english: The barrier-free path leads from the car parks to the lowest waterfall, including wheelchair-accessible toilets.

stops.name: uppermost waterfall
stops.quote: Those continuing to the uppermost waterfall should be reasonably fit and sure-footed.
stops.english: Those continuing to the uppermost waterfall should be reasonably fit and sure-footed.

stops.name: Krimml Waterfall Trail
stops.quote: The Krimml Waterfall Trail is open every day from 1st May until the end of October (admission fee applies).
stops.english: The Krimml Waterfall Trail is open every day from 1st May until the end of October (admission fee applies).

stops.name: Krimml WaterWorlds
stops.quote: The Krimml WaterWorlds offer an interactive experience centred around the element of water, located right next to the Krimml Waterfalls.
stops.english: The Krimml WaterWorlds offer an interactive experience centred around the element of water, located right next to the Krimml Waterfalls.

stops.name: village of Krimml
stops.quote: The Krimml Waterfalls are situated in the village of Krimml in the Hohe Tauern National Park in SalzburgerLand.
stops.english: The Krimml Waterfalls are situated in the village of Krimml in the Hohe Tauern National Park in SalzburgerLand.

stops.name: Tauern Cycle Path
stops.quote: A leisurely ride along great rivers, cultural highlights and culinary discoveries: the Tauern Cycle Path through the Alps never fails to impress.
stops.english: A leisurely ride along great rivers, cultural highlights and culinary discoveries: the Tauern Cycle Path through the Alps never fails to impress.
